music.label: Music
music.description: Listen to music in voice channels (YouTube, SoundCloud, Spotify…) through a Lavalink server.
music.notConfigured: ❌ Music isn't configured on this host (no Lavalink server).
music.nodeDown: ❌ The Lavalink server is unreachable. Check it's running (`docker compose ps`) and that LAVALINK_HOST / LAVALINK_PASSWORD are correct.
music.joinFailed: ❌ Couldn't join your voice channel (missing Connect / Speak permissions?).
music.playError: ❌ Something went wrong during playback. Try again in a moment.
music.notSameChannel: ❌ You must be in the same voice channel as the bot.
music.noPermission: ❌ Reserved to the DJ role (or “Manage Server”).
music.skippedEnd: ⏭️ Last track skipped, end of the queue.
music.queueTooShort: ❌ Not enough tracks in the queue to shuffle.
music.cannotSeek: ❌ Can't seek in this track (live or missing).

command.play: Play a track or add it to the queue (search or link).
command.playQuery: Title to search or a link (YouTube, SoundCloud…).
command.playSource: Search platform (when it isn't a link).
command.stop: Stop playback and clear the queue.
command.seek: Seek to a position in the track.
command.remove: Remove a track from the queue.
command.disconnect: Disconnect the bot from the voice channel.
